Shaded boards are panel hubs. Each hub slot carries 12 V, the I2C bus, RST and one INT line (the INT name is under each slot). Addresses and board numbers: 0xNN · KC-01-NNNN. Sources: Hardware Inventory §2–§7, Hardware Reference §3.6, §5, §7, §10.
